{"proof":"  have hmem : ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ S ↔ x = 8 ∨ x = -14 := by
    intro x
    rw [h₀ x]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hfact : (x + 3 - 11) * (x + 3 + 11) = 0 := by nlinarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfact with h | h
      · left
        nlinarith
      · right
        nlinarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  have hS : S = {8, -14} := by
    ext x
    rw [hmem]
    simp
  rw [hS]
  simp"}
